description: React component for an Event Logging page, including UI for viewing, filtering, and creating event logs related to production, downtime, and quality events. It interacts with an API for listing and creating event logs.

classes.name: TabButton
classes.description: A button component to toggle between different event categories (Production, Downtime, Quality).

classes.name: EventForm
classes.description: A form component for creating new event log entries with fields varying based on event type.

methods.name: EventsPage
methods.description: Main React component rendering the event logging interface, including event list, filtering tabs, and modal for new entries.

methods.name: TabButton
methods.description: Component for rendering category selection buttons with active state styling.

methods.name: EventForm
methods.description: Component for inputting details of a new event log entry, with dynamic fields based on event type.
